name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional ('If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first'), so at_exit is only the condition of an 'if' and is never commanded; the single hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) (switch first, exit not before it) exactly states the requirement, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
